payload.name: Category-question concrete-instance search
payload.description: When a question asks for activities or items in a broad category (e.g., outdoor activities, hobbies, foods) and initial retrieval returns no concrete instances, run additional searches using common concrete examples of that category with the subject's name.
content: When a question asks for a list in a broad category (e.g., outdoor activities, hobbies, foods) and the initial search returns no memories naming concrete items, run 1-2 additional hybrid or keyword searches pairing the subject's name with common concrete examples of that category (e.g., for outdoor: surfing, hiking, running, cycling). Stop once relevant concrete-item memories are found; do not enumerate exhaustively.

solves: Category-label questions (e.g., 'What outdoor activities does John enjoy?') can fail when memories store concrete instances (e.g., surfing) without the category label, so a search using only the category phrase misses them. This Skill applies when a question asks for a list of items in a broad category and the first retrieval returns no concrete items; it instructs running additional searches using common concrete examples of that category with the subject's name. It does not apply when the initial search already surfaces concrete items, or when the question targets a single named activity.
